items.title: MCP Goes Stateless, and Developers Ask Whether That Just Makes It an API Again
items.blurb: The MCP 2026-07-28 specification removes the initialize handshake and session header, and adds required method and tool-name headers so gateways can route agent traffic without parsing JSON.

items.title: Bypassing Android Hardware Attestation from the Analyst's Chair
items.blurb: Hardware key attestation lets an Android app prove to its backend that a key lives in secure hardware on a locked, verified device. It is also the wall that stops a security analyst working on a rooted phone.
